text:
sam: Quick check - I'd like to propose a tiny change to rollout metadata so resolvers can cheaply decide fallbacks without downloading full manifests. Idea: keep a short 'bundle_label' and a compact 'compat_sigil' (machine-friendly) plus a 'sigil_version'. Thoughts?

anya: Sounds useful. We should be explicit about what compat means: API surface compatibility (prompt/response contract), binary/runtime compatibility (quant/hw), and operational (latency/cpu).

kevin: Agreed. Implementation note: keep bundle_label minimal (model-family/variant) and let compat_sigil be a stable, parseable token list. Avoid stuffing human-readable tags into the label.

maria: From ops POV we need deprecation metadata so clients can warn users and we can run rollbacks. Proposed extra fields: deprecation_ts, migration_window_days, pin_strength (soft|hard), fallback_policy (ordered|best-fit). Also emit telemetry when resolver picks a non-primary target.

sam: Early strawman for layout (all fields are strings or arrays so clients can inspect quickly):
```
bundle_label: "guanaco-7b/dense"
sigil_version: "1"
compat_sigil: "hw:gpu|quant:int8|kv:2|api:stable"
pin_strength: "soft"
fallback_policy: "ordered"
deprecation_ts: "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
fallback_candidates: ["guanaco-7b/int8","guanaco-7b/fp16"]
```
compat_sigil is pipe-delimited key:value pairs; ordering is irrelevant and parser must canonicalize. sigil_version lets us evolve format.

ops-runbook-bot: note: created draft runbook ticket referencing these fields -> /tickets/RB-1423

kevin: Two tradeoffs to call out: (1) extra parsing burden on embedded/lightweight clients; we should keep parser tiny and introduce libraries in SDKs. (2) runtime routers need to be conservative when interpreting unknown keys in sigil (fail-safe to treat unknown as incompatible unless policy says otherwise).

anya: On wildcards: allow simple prefix wildcard for labels in rollout rules (e.g., 'guanaco-7b/*') to enable family-wide toggles. Disallow complex globbing to keep resolver O(1) checks. Document: prefix-only, no character classes.

maria: Telemetry hooks: resolver_fallback event with {requested_label, chosen_label, reason_code, sigil_mismatch_keys}. Ops will alert if fallback_rate > 0.5% for 1h. Also include migration_id so we can correlate client-side fallbacks to a rollout plan.

sam: Good point about migration_id. I'll add migration_id as a short UUID string and require rollout manifests to include it. Also propose pin_strength semantics: hard = deny fallback, soft = allow fallback to chain.

kevin: Parser stability: require that compat keys are ASCII letters/numbers and values be short tokens. Document delimiter as '|' and kv separator as ':'. Encourage numeric versions for values when possible (e.g., kv:2).

anya: Back-compat: we'll publish a tiny resolver-shim (JS/Python) that understands sigil_version=1 and falls back to manifest fetch otherwise. Include a feature-flag gate to rollout shim to mobile/old clients.

maria: I'll update the deprecation playbook to include migration_id checks and telemetry thresholds. Ops wants a dry-run mode where we set pin_strength soft and monitor fallback events for 48h before flipping to hard.

sam: OK — plan: I'll submit schema PR with fields: bundle_label, sigil_version, compat_sigil, pin_strength, fallback_policy, fallback_candidates, migration_id, deprecation_ts. Add SDK helper and resolver-shim. Follow-up: RFC update with canonical key list for compat_sigil (hw, quant, kv, api, latency_class).

kevin: Tiny nit: rename 'compat_sigil' -> 'compat_sigil' consistent naming is fine but let's avoid synonyms across docs. Also include example of mismatch reason codes for telemetry (SIGIL_MISMATCH, PIN_HARD, NO_CAPACITY).

anya: +1. I'll add the canonical key doc and signal semantics.

maria: Filing ops checklist and ticket to wire alerts.

sam: Thanks all. I'll push PR and link runbook/ticket after. :shipit:
